facts.fact: FIJ says the NITDA Standard and Guidelines for government websites, made under the NITDA Act 2007, require inclusivity for people with disabilities and adoption of W3C WCAG.
facts.system: NITDA Standard and Guidelines for government websites

facts.fact: FIJ assessed all 36 state websites and the FCT against the NITDA guidelines and found 14 of the 36 states have images without text alternatives.
